div.div: Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh

This form will be used for the taxpayers required/willing to get registered/enlistment under the Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty Act, 2012. Please read the instructions pages at the end of this form carefully and fill ALL applicable fields correctly. Please contact our help-desk at 16555 if you need any assistance.
